rationale: The original thesis relied on price holding the tight $48.34–$48.44 consolidation range and the 5-minute 9-EMA for an immediate breakout above $48.45. After 22 minutes without upward follow-through, price has broken down through both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($48.37) and the consolidation floor at $48.34, negating the breakout setup while strong earnings and elevated relative volume above VWAP ($47.63) make flipping short unattractive.
